name: Residence Permit for Guest Self-Employment

requirements.blocker_text: Must prove sufficient means of subsistence via bank statements, tax-authority income certificates, or business-activity declarations. No fixed minimum capital amount is specified.

Requires a detailed declaration of business activity supported by credible evidence (business contract, service contract, agreement, sales/purchase contract), for either independently performed self-employed work, or a chief-executive role managing a business organisation, cooperative, or other legal entity established for gainful activity.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare a documented business-activity declaration with supporting contracts.

evidence_required.document: Proof of financial means (bank statements, tax certificates)

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year initially, extendable by up to 2 additional years, maximum 3 years from first issuance

sources.title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) -- Residence Permit for Guest Self-Employment: means-of-subsistence and business-activity-declaration requirements, 1+2 year duration cap, 1-year family-reunification bar, explicit National Residence Card exclusion

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. family_can_join set false at the route level as a conservative simplification: family reunification is restricted for the FIRST YEAR from permit issuance only (birth-in-Hungary exception aside), then becomes available -- the schema's boolean cannot represent this time-gated eligibility, so it is flagged here rather than asserted as a blanket 'no'. UNUSUAL STATUTORY SPLIT flagged: the source explicitly states holders 'may not be granted a national residence card' (hu_national_residence_card is barred to this route by law), yet time on this permit still plausibly counts toward the general 8-year (or 3-year reduced) residence clock for hu_naturalisation -- meaning this route can lead toward ordinary Hungarian citizenship eligibility while never leading toward Hungary's own national permanent-residence card. leads_to_pr set false to reflect that specific statutory bar.
